title: TORAI++ : a post-processing fix for TORAI's aggregation-blindness
mechanism: TORAI ranks services by anomaly severity. In systems with aggregation points (Online Boutique frontend/checkoutservice), a code-level fault in a leaf service produces its loudest anomalies in the aggregator, which is a victim, not a cause. TORAI++ re-ranks using the call graph: services with many anomalous callees are penalized (treated as victims).
sanity_check: TORAI on the authors own torai-OB dataset reproduces the paper exactly: CPU 0.96, MEM 0.93, DISK 1.0, SOCKET 0.92, DELAY 0.80, LOSS 0.87.
